sentences.en: His poor reading ability impedes his progress in the class.
sentences.zh: 他的阅读能力差阻碍了他在班级中的进步。

sentences.en: The government was impeding on the rights of its citizens.
sentences.zh: 政府侵犯了公民的权利。

sentences.en: Obstructions near doors can impede people in an emergency.
sentences.zh: 门附近如果有障碍物，会妨碍紧急情况下的人员通行。
